assessment.grayBandCause: MISSING GROUND COVERAGE (缺地面), not a missing face in an existing mesh, not a flipped/reversed face, not a material assignment. The interfaces a-floor mesh is complete and its 'paving-frontage' material is correct; its east EDGE simply lies 1.0-1.6m west of N06's real wall line because A_PTS used assumed face positions. Between that edge and N06's visible wall (and north of N06 to the portal) ~6.4 m2 of the entrance view has no surface at all — the page background (pale gray) shows through, reading as the 'gray band' right of the stone paving.
